acceptanceCriteria: An archived predecessor with an older legacy successorBindingMode candidate and a newer valid successor/revalidation record can complete the supported close path without rewriting either predecessor record.

The older legacy recovery bytes remain immutable and are classified only as stale historical binding when a newer valid candidate is present; malformed, foreign, contradictory, or sole invalid records remain fail-closed.
The close-bound projection preserves the original recovery path, digest, sequence, and successor lineage and does not reclassify a PR finalization as direct_merge_no_pr.
Regression tests cover the compatibility path and negative cases, and the three-language recovery documentation describes the append-only rule and recovery boundary.
goal: Provide a first-class, append-only compatibility path for closing an archived predecessor after a valid successor supersedes an older legacy recovery binding.
intent: Fix the Runtime recovery-decision loader so a known historical successorBindingMode conflict is treated as stale only when a newer valid successor record binds the same immutable predecessor; retain fail-closed behavior for every unrelated invalid record.
